# opencode companion

> opencode companion (formerly opencode remote) is an iPhone app for the opencode AI coding agent. The agent runs on your own computer; the app lets you follow sessions live, approve permissions, review diffs and send instructions from your phone. End-to-end encrypted relay, no account, no VPN. 7-day free trial, then one one-time payment, no subscription.

## App
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6813434085?ct=llms): download the iPhone app
- [Product page](https://raaulalonso.github.io/opencode-remote-privacy/app.html): features, quick start and FAQ

## Docs
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/raaulalonso/opencode-remote): source code, README, protocol documentation
- [ocremote on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ocremote): the companion that runs next to opencode (npx ocremote --pair)
- [Support](https://raaulalonso.github.io/opencode-remote-privacy/support.html)
- [Privacy policy](https://raaulalonso.github.io/opencode-remote-privacy/index.html): the app collects no personal data

## Quick start
1. npm install -g opencode-ai, then opencode auth login (once)
2. npx ocremote --pair on the computer, which shows a QR code
3. Open the app and scan the QR code
